# === Core ===

# Pin a release, e.g. AGENT_SWARM_VERSION=1.150.0. Blank tracks `latest`.
AGENT_SWARM_VERSION=

INSTALL_PRESET=full

# New-deployment memory preset: retrieval, citation ratings, self-rating hints.
# Set MEMORY_RATERS= to disable all raters; leave SKIP_SESSION_SUMMARY unset.
MEMORY_HYBRID_SEARCH=1
MEMORY_GRAPH_EXPANSION=1
MEMORY_RATERS=implicit-citation,explicit-self
MEMORY_DEMOTION_FLOOR=1.0

# === Authentication ===

AWS_PROFILE=example-profile
MODEL_OVERRIDE=example-model
